records.freshness_rationale: Class C frontend architecture is accepted against current browser-platform evidence and a representative CMDR benchmark, but the Web platform, security guidance and compared framework/toolchain landscape evolve quickly enough to require a quarterly review or immediate event-driven revalidation.

signals.detail: No selected third-party UI runtime exists; current Web Platform and compared-framework evidence does not invalidate the selected first-party architecture. Revisit on material browser-platform or compared-runtime version change.
No reviewed current security evidence invalidates the first-party Web Platform architecture; CSP and safe DOM APIs remain mandatory and Trusted Types remains defense in depth.
The Class C adversarial review found no blocking threat-model issue when authorization remains server-side and unsafe DOM sinks are excluded.
BENCH-0001 shows the selected candidate within the measured workload has low repeated-update cost; any material regression or fixture change requires revalidation.
The saturated research packet reports no unresolved critical claim and no additional source family that materially changes the candidate set as of the review date.
